prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Mina Castellan after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: GA4 migration and tracking plan
client: Verdant Skincare
client_industry: e-commerce
start: 2023-04
end: 2023-05
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Google Analytics
- Google Tag Manager
- BigQuery
implied_skills:
- event tracking
built: A tracking plan and GTM setup moving the shop from Universal Analytics to GA4
  before the cut-off.
metrics:
- 46 events mapped
- no gap in year-on-year reporting

The review is from: Verdant Skincare
Rating: 4.5 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- Focus mostly on speed and deadlines; do not just repeat the project summary.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "event tracking".
text: Mina moved quickly and helped us get the migration done before the cutoff, which was the main thing we needed. The work was handled efficiently, and we ended up with a clear tracking plan and GTM setup in place without any gap in year-on-year reporting. She mapped 46 events and stayed focused on the deadline throughout.
